The sheer weight of this thing would catch the average person off guard just from them trying to pull it inside their house or something. The crate’s wood surface was moderately lukewarm. With a smooth outer feeling, the planks were painstakingly meticulous in their completeness; this was a telltale sign of severe professionalism, as no splinters were to be found anywhere on this package. Tails was based off of a titular kitsune supergenius, like those from the stories—of brutal missions, of Mobians and machines, of a sole purpose in eradication.
